notes.title: Update 1.3.1 The no limits update (With limits)
notes.notes:
+ Made Branches stop spawning at 500 branches
+ Branches no longer stop spawning at a certain time
+ Made items stop spawning at 500 branches
+ Items no longer stop spawning at a certain time
+ Increased max world branches by 15 (45 -> 60)
+ Increased barrel max to 250 to start (50 -> 250)
+ Increased barrel gen upgrade to + 100 barrel max (75 -> 100)
+ Made firekeeper take effect at 5% heat instead of 20%
+ Bigger Barrel now increases barrel max by 5 (2 -> 5)
+ Bigger barrel max upgrades is now 200 (80 -> 200)
+ Big pockets max upgrades is now 10 (8 -> 10)

notes.title: July Balancing Changes
notes.notes: [h2]Version 1.2.3[/h2][p][/p][p]This update addresses several changes for the overall balancing of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]= Fixed display of mult upgrade being 250 sticks to purchase when it was actually 350 sticks[/p][p]+ Made record player easier to control[/p][p]+ Branches now stop spawning when you pick up 200 (130 -> 200)[/p][p]+ Branches now stop spawning at 30 minutes (20 -> 30)[/p][p]+ Items now stop spawning when you pick up 150 sticks (100 -> 150)[/p][p]+ Items now stop spawning at 15 minutes (10 -> 15)[/p][p]+ Big pockets max purchases is now 8 (3 -> 8)[/p][p]+ Windy weather max purchases is now 60 (30 -> 60)[/p][p]+ Bigger Barrels max purchases is now 80 (50 -> 80)[/p][p]+ Old newspapers max purchases is now 8 (3 -> 8)[/p][p]+ Coals max purchases is now 10 (5 -> 10)[/p][p]+ Mult max purchases is now 8 (3 -> 8)[/p][p]+ Item max max purchases is now 15 (10 -> 15)[/p][p]+ Backpack now doubles your carry capacity when chosen instead of a base +2 max[/p][p]+ Boots now give +1.5 speed (1 -> 1.5)[/p][p]- Boots now decrease time for cold by 0.3s (0.2s -> 0.3s)[/p][p]+ Fire kit now increases duration by 4s (2s -> 4s)[/p][p]+ Fire kit now increases range by 0.5m[/p][p]- Fire kit now makes fire at home lose 1.5% (1% -> 1.5%)[/p][p]+ Barrel now generates a stick every 25s (30s -> 25s)[/p][p]+ Barrel increases barrel max by 75 (50 -> 75)[/p][p]- Barrel now makes world branch max -20 (8 -> 20)[/p][p]+ Magnet range is now 7m (5m - 7m)[/p][p]+ Magnet now boosts run speed by 0.2[/p][p]+ Magnet branch percent penalty reduced to 1.5% (2% -> 1.5%)[/p]
